notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello you brave warriors

Just a small update with some fixes to some issues brought to our attention.

# Fixed networking crashes in lobby.
# Fixed the brain level sometimes not loading properly.
# Added new boss, (testing required).
# Added new animations.
# New upgrades available
# vs AI added to lobby if you do not have network access.

Enjoy ;)
